messages:
Sally (AE): Quick sync on Aurora Telecom POC — scope draft below, want to lock success criteria and sandbox flow this week. TL;DR: sample CDRs + call transcripts, PII redaction, SFTP ingest + option for pre-redacted S3, 2-week eval window. @Mike can you confirm pricing / trial credits?
Mike (SE): Ack — available for a call today. On pricing: we can offer a 2-week trial w/ 50k free tokens + sandbox infra credits. Need finance sign-off for Dedicated slot.
Elena (Solutions): Redaction approach suggestion: ingest into staging S3, run a light pipeline that strips phone/email/SSNs via regex and named-entity checks, then run model evals. We can hand them a pre-redacted CSV to start while we set up SFTP. Example redaction regex we use: /(?:(?:\+?1\s*)?\(?\d{3}\)?[\s.-]?\d{3}[\s.-]?\d{4})/ for US phones.
Jacob (Infra): I can provision a VPC-isolated sandbox in us-west-2. Need list of CIDR egress rules for Aurora's IPs or we can do SFTP over a bastion. ETA: 24-48h after access request.
Sally (AE): Success criteria (proposed):
- SC1: End-to-end demo with sample dataset ingested and redacted in sandbox
- SC2: PII redaction precision >= 99% on our 500-sample audit set
- SC3: Integration: file ingest via SFTP + verified write to redacted S3 path
- SC4: Performance: inference p95 < 150ms for 512-token gen on the hosted config (or parity on Dedicated)
- SC5: Running eval prompts (n=100) with no quality regressions vs baseline prompts
Can we align on these?
Mike (SE): SCs look good. For SC4 we should add token-cost budget so they don't run open-ended tests — suggest 100k tokens cap for trial.
Elena (Solutions): On eval prompts: I'll draft 12 canonical prompts (summarize, extract action items, identify entities, redact PII, paraphrase) and expected structured outputs. Example prompt: "Summarize this 3-min call and extract action items with owners" -> expected: action_items: list, owners: list, due_dates: list (we'll evaluate F1 on owner extraction).
Jacob (Infra): infra-bot note: provisioning started.
infra-bot: sandbox-aurora-2006543210: provisioning initiated. S3 path: s3://redwood-sandbox/aurora/2006543210/temp/ — creds will be generated and emailed, expiry 7d.
Sally (AE): @Elena please include a small QA checklist for redaction edge cases (timestamps, obfuscated numbers, misspelled emails). Also need the wording for the security questionnaire section about data residency and KMS.
Elena (Solutions): Draft: "Data stored in customer-dedicated S3 prefix in us-west-2, encrypted with CMK (AWS KMS). Only SE and infra roles assigned to POC have decryption perms. Audit logs retained 30 days." Will add to the questionnaire doc.
Mike (SE): I'll push the updated SOW + trial credit note to the customer. Also need to flag a potential enterprise blocker: they may require SOC2 type attestations for longer trials — if they ask for a 90-day Dedicated trial we need legal+security OK.
Sally (AE): Noted. For now 2-week sandbox is our ask. Jacob, can you produce SFTP credentials and sample ingest instructions (curl or sftp examples)?
Jacob (Infra): Yes. Sample SFTP snippet I'll add:
```
# upload via sftp
sftp -i ~/.ssh/aurora_poc.pem aurora_user@poc-ssh.redwood.example:/upload <<EOF
put sample_calls.csv
EOF
```
Credentials will be seeded into LastPass + emailed to contact on the allowlist.
Elena (Solutions): Who owns redaction QA? I can run the initial 500-sample audit but need someone from Aurora to spot-check the outputs (we'll provide an audit template).
Sally (AE): Assigning redaction QA to Elena for the POC deliverable, Aurora will sign off via the checklist.
Mike (SE): Next steps: 1) infra request (Jacob) 2) SOW + credits (Mike) 3) eval prompt pack + expected outputs (Elena) 4) kickoff call with Aurora tomorrow 10:00 PT (Sally to confirm).
Sally (AE): I'll confirm demo time and send calendar invite. Thanks all — keep updates in this thread, add any blockers. :thumbsup:
